label.purpose: Field labels and compact UI chrome.

shadows.name: hairline-lift
shadows.purpose: Optional micro-separator on dense rows — not card elevation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill CTA — Stage Rose hit for primary host actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.65rem 1.1rem; min-height: 2.75rem; font: 700 1rem/1.2 "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; background: oklch(0.62 0.16 353); color: oklch(0.98 0.01 353); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.78 0.12 185); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { appearance: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.65rem 1.1rem; min-height: 2.75rem; font: 700 1rem/1.2 "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.96 0.012 353); border: 1px solid oklch(0.96 0.01 353 / 0.12); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.20 0.014 353); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.78 0.12 185); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; font-family: "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.96 0.012 353); } .ds-field > span { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.84 0.02 353); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.96 0.01 353 / 0.12); background: oklch(0.08 0 0); color: oklch(0.96 0.012 353); padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem; font: inherit; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.72 0.02 353); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.78 0.12 185); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Matte booth panel — border + tonal fill, no ghost shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: oklch(0.16 0.012 353); color: oklch(0.96 0.012 353); border: 1px solid oklch(0.96 0.01 353 / 0.12); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; font-family: "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 0.35rem; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: oklch(0.84 0.02 353); font-size: 0.9rem; }

components.name: Role Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font: 600 0.7rem/1 "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.84 0.02 353); background: oklch(0.20 0.014 353); border: 1px solid oklch(0.96 0.01 353 / 0.12); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem; }

components.name: Top Nav Link
components.description: Pill nav — active uses Panel Lift.
components.html: DashboardMap
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.35rem; font-family: "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { color: oklch(0.84 0.02 353); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: oklch(0.96 0.012 353); background: oklch(0.20 0.014 353); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: oklch(0.96 0.012 353); background: oklch(0.20 0.014 353); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.78 0.12 185); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: Syne wordmark — only place display type is allowed.
components.css: .ds-brand { margin: 0; font-family: Syne, "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-size: 1.5rem; color: oklch(0.96 0.012 353); } .ds-brand span { color: oklch(0.62 0.16 353); }

narrative.overview:
PlayOn’s UI is a LAN control booth after midnight: matte black gear, rose stage light, cyan live indicators. It is a product tool first — dense host surfaces for same-night ops, and a calmer scan-first `/play` panel for phones. Personality stays sharp, playful, trustworthy: fun without toyish, dense without SaaS-cream.

Depth comes from tonal surface steps and hairline borders, not glass stacks or ambient drop shadows. Interaction chroma should punch like arcade hits on CTAs and live state — rose and cyan used as deliberate hits against the dark booth, not as wallpaper.

This system explicitly rejects purple-on-white AI dashboards, cream/terracotta editorial kits, neon cyberpunk glassmorphism, generic “admin admin” Bootstrap panels, and hero-metric SaaS cards.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained matte surfaces; rose primary and cyan accent as high-impact hits
Single UI family (DM Sans) with Syne reserved for the PlayOn wordmark
Pill CTAs, 12px panels, tonal elevation (borders over shadows)
Host booth density vs calm player panel tempo
State-change motion only (150–220ms ease-out); reduced-motion respected

rules.name: The Stage-Light Rule
rules.body: Rose and cyan are arcade hits, not atmosphere. Keep saturated color on CTAs, status, focus, and brand marks — roughly ≤10–15% of any host screen. If the whole surface glows, turn it down.

rules.name: The AA Mute Rule
rules.body: Never drop muted body text below AA against `--bg`. If it feels elegant but hard to read, brighten `--muted` toward ink.

rules.name: The Wordmark Fence
rules.body: Syne appears only on the PlayOn mark. Buttons, nav, fields, and data stay DM Sans.

rules.name: The One Edge Rule
rules.body: Use a border or a soft shadow for decoration — never both on the same element. Prefer border + tonal fill.

dos: Do keep the booth dark and matte; let Stage Rose and Live Cyan land as deliberate hits.
Do put conversation/map first for hosts; keep `/play` calmer and scan-first on phones.
Do use pill primary CTAs and 12px panels consistently across admin surfaces.
Do reserve Syne for the PlayOn wordmark only.
Do animate state changes only (≈150–220ms, `--ease`); honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do meet WCAG AA for body/muted text and keep keyboard focus visible (cyan ring).
donts: Don't drift into cream/terracotta editorial kits.
Don't use neon cyberpunk glassmorphism (blur stacks, glow soup, holographic panels).
Don't fall back to generic “admin admin” Bootstrap panels.
Don't use hero-metric SaaS cards as layout scaffolding.
Don't pair `1px` decorative borders with wide soft drop shadows on the same element.
Don't put Syne (or any display face) on buttons, labels, or data.
Don't paint large surfaces in saturated rose/cyan — hits, not wallpaper.
